## The first release

GamePreset Peek shows the optimal game settings NVIDIA recommends for your PC, without installing NVIDIA App.

- **Your games and all games.** The "My games" tab lists the games installed on this PC, found in the folders you choose; "All games" lists every game NVIDIA has recommendations for. Both have box art and a search field.
- **Your hardware.** The processor, the NVIDIA graphics card, the memory and the screen resolution are detected; the processor, the graphics card and the resolution can be changed to see the settings for another PC.
- **Every preset.** The recommended preset is shown first; a slider goes through the other presets NVIDIA has for the game, from performance to quality, and the values that differ from the recommended ones are marked.
- **Five languages.** The program and the setting names are in English, Russian, German, French and Spanish.
- **Light and dark themes**, or the one Windows uses.
- **Weekly updates** of the lists of processors, graphics cards and games, without a new version of the program.
- **Normal or portable installation**: for one Windows user, or into any folder such as a USB stick.
